sections.title: Housing
data: Families lease on the local market through the Housing Office on the pier, in Building 752, which keeps listings. Homes are apartments and town houses in Gaeta and villas in the countryside; towns such as Formia, Scauri and Minturno offer larger homes that fit U.S. furniture.
Expect to pay the first and last month's rent and a security deposit in cash, in euros, before move-in. OHA includes an amount for utilities.

sections.title: Housing allowance (OHA, not BAH)
data: Italy is an overseas location for housing allowances. Service members who live off base receive the Overseas Housing Allowance (OHA) instead of BAH. OHA is set by rank, dependents and the actual rent, up to a ceiling, with separate amounts for utilities and move-in costs.
Check your own figures with the official OHA calculator before you sign a lease.

source.label: Defense Travel Management Office, Overseas Housing Allowance

sections.title: Schools
data: Gaeta is served by the DoDEA schools at NSA Naples. The directory notes that new arrivals assigned to Gaeta units can no longer use the DoDEA school bus from Gaeta, and that families with school-age children are encouraged to live at the Naples support site or on a current bus route. Talk to the school liaison before you choose where to live.
